notes: *neither* goes to the present negative אַל and *nor* to the waw, which is exactly rule 14's limit on correlative pairs.

קוֹל is read as the causative's object realized discontinuously by *it ... proclaimed*, leaving *they caused ... to be* with the verb. The competing reading (the whole passive frame on the verb, קוֹל holding only *it*) is named in the review notes; under rule 8 it would sit better in the s006 unit note.
